description: Mobile companion app for Claude Code - Answer questions on the go, monitor progress from anywhere

userStories.title: MCP Server Setup
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a working MCP server scaffold so that Claude Code can communicate with CacheBash
acceptanceCriteria: MCP server initializes and registers with Claude Code
Server exposes tool definitions to Claude
userStories.technicalNotes: Use @modelcontextprotocol/sdk package. TypeScript with strict mode. Configuration: API key, Firebase credentials, session ID.

userStories.title: Ask Question Tool
userStories.description: As Claude, I want to send a question to the user's mobile device so that I can get clarification without blocking
acceptanceCriteria: ask_question tool accepts: question text, options (optional), priority
Question is stored in Firestore with timestamp and session context
Push notification is triggered via Cloud Function
Tool returns a question ID for tracking
userStories.technicalNotes: Interface: { question: string, options?: string[], priority: 'low' | 'normal' | 'high', context?: string }

userStories.title: Get Response Tool
userStories.description: As Claude, I want to check if the user has responded to my question so that I can continue the pinned task
acceptanceCriteria: Returns response if available, null if pending
Includes response timestamp and any user notes
Can query multiple question IDs at once
userStories.technicalNotes: Poll-based initially, could add WebSocket later. Cache responses locally to reduce API calls.

userStories.title: Update Status Tool
userStories.description: As Claude, I want to update my current working status so that the user can see progress in the app
acceptanceCriteria: update_status tool accepts: status text, progress %, task ID
Status updates in real-time in the app
userStories.technicalNotes: Interface: { status: string, progress?: number, taskId?: string, state: 'working' | 'blocked' | 'complete' | 'pinned' }

userStories.title: Pin/Resume Task Tools
userStories.description: As Claude, I want to pin a task while waiting for a response and resume it later so that I can work on other tasks in the meantime
acceptanceCriteria: pin_task stores current context and reason for pin
Multiple tasks can be pinned simultaneously
Pin includes: task ID, question ID, context summary
Resume provides full context to continue work
userStories.technicalNotes: Store pin context in Firestore for persistence. Include enough context to resume without prior conversation.

userStories.title: Firestore Schema Setup
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a well-designed Firestore schema so that data is organized and queries are efficient
acceptanceCriteria: Collections defined: users, sessions, questions, responses, devices
userStories.technicalNotes: Collections: /users/{userId}, /users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}, /users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}, /users/{userId}/questions/{questionId}

userStories.title: Cloud Functions for Push
userStories.description: As a user, I want to receive push notifications when Claude asks a question so that I'm alerted immediately
acceptanceCriteria: Function triggers on new question document
Sends push to all user's registered devices
High priority questions use high-priority push
userStories.technicalNotes: Use Firebase Admin SDK. Configure APNs for iOS. Include question ID in notification payload for deep linking.

userStories.title: API Key Authentication
userStories.description: As a user, I want secure API key authentication so that only I can access my sessions
acceptanceCriteria: API keys are generated securely (256-bit random)
Key validation is fast and secure
Key can be regenerated if compromised
userStories.technicalNotes: Generate in app, hash and store. MCP server validates key on each request. Include user ID in key for fast lookup.

userStories.title: Flutter App Project Setup
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a well-structured Flutter project so that development is organized and scalable
acceptanceCriteria: Flutter project initialized with proper package name
Firebase configured for iOS and Android
userStories.technicalNotes: Package name: com.cachebash.app. Use flutter_riverpod for state, go_router for navigation. Firebase packages: firebase_core, cloud_firestore, firebase_messaging.

userStories.title: Device Registration and Auth
userStories.description: As a user, I want to pair my device with my API key so that I can receive notifications
userStories.technicalNotes: Store API key securely (flutter_secure_storage). Request notification permissions. Generate and store FCM token.

userStories.title: Sessions List View
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see all my active Claude sessions so that I can monitor multiple projects
acceptanceCriteria: List shows all sessions with status
userStories.technicalNotes: Use StreamBuilder with Firestore. Show last update time relative (e.g., '2 min ago'). Badge for pending questions.

userStories.title: Session Detail View
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see detailed status of a Claude session so that I know exactly what Claude is working on
acceptanceCriteria: List of pinned tasks for this session
userStories.technicalNotes: Real-time status updates. Scrollable history with timestamps. Visual progress bar if progress % available.

userStories.title: Questions Queue View
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see and respond to Claude's questions so that I can unblock Claude's work
acceptanceCriteria: List of pending questions across all sessions
Sorted by priority, then by time
Session context shown with each question
Quick reply for multiple choice questions
userStories.technicalNotes: Badge count on tab for pending questions. Haptic feedback on interaction. Offline queue for responses.

userStories.title: Question Response Flow
userStories.description: As a user, I want to respond to a question so that Claude can continue working
acceptanceCriteria: Open questions show text input with suggestions
Can add notes with any response
userStories.technicalNotes: Optimistic UI update. Offline support (queue and sync). Push response to MCP server via webhook.

userStories.title: Push Notification Handling
userStories.description: As a user, I want to receive and interact with push notifications so that I'm alerted to new questions
userStories.technicalNotes: Configure firebase_messaging for foreground/background. Deep linking to specific question. iOS: configure APNs, request permissions. Android: configure notification channel.

userStories.title: Offline Support
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to work offline so that I can respond even without internet
userStories.technicalNotes: Firestore offline persistence enabled. Queue responses in local storage. Sync on connectivity change.

userStories.title: Analytics Data Collection
userStories.description: As a developer, I want analytics events tracked so that users can see their usage patterns
acceptanceCriteria: Track: questions asked, response times, session duration
userStories.technicalNotes: Cloud Function to aggregate on schedule. Store in /users/{userId}/analytics collection.

userStories.title: Analytics View
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my usage analytics so that I can understand my patterns
userStories.technicalNotes: Use fl_chart for visualizations. Cache analytics data locally. Pull to refresh.

userStories.title: TestFlight Setup
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the app deployed to TestFlight so that beta testing can begin
acceptanceCriteria: iOS build signed with distribution certificate
App uploaded to App Store Connect
userStories.technicalNotes: Configure Xcode signing. Use flutter build ipa. Upload via Transporter or altool.

userStories.title: Android Internal Testing
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the app on Google Play internal testing so that Android testing can begin
acceptanceCriteria: Android build signed with upload key
userStories.technicalNotes: Configure signing in build.gradle. Use flutter build appbundle. Upload via Play Console.
